prompt:
Crea una slide Instagram portrait (1080x1350) per Finvestire sul tema 'il costo dell'attesa'.

STRUTTURA: usa un singolo div root con position:'absolute', width:1080, height:1350, overflow:'hidden', display:'flex', flexDirection:'column'. Dentro, quattro sezioni in ordine dall'alto:

1. HEADER (flex-shrink:0, height:110px, background brand-navy): testo centrato 'IL COSTO DELL'ATTESA' in bianco, fontWeight:800, fontSize:26, letterSpacing:3.

2. CARDS (flex-shrink:0, padding:'40px 48px 0 48px'): un div con display:'flex', flexDirection:'row', gap:24. Due card figlie con flex:1 (NON larghezza fissa), padding:32, borderRadius:20.
   - Card SINISTRA background brand-navy: label 'INIZI A 25 ANNI' in brand-gold uppercase fontSize:13 fontWeight:700, numero '€ 487.000' in bianco fontSize:64 fontWeight:800 marginTop:20, nota '€ 200/mese · 30 anni · 7% reale' in rgba(255,255,255,0.6) fontSize:14 marginTop:16.
   - Card DESTRA background:'#E8E0D0' position:'relative': label 'INIZI A 35 ANNI' in muted uppercase fontSize:13 fontWeight:600, numero '€ 189.000' in brand-navy fontSize:64 fontWeight:800 marginTop:20, stessa nota in muted fontSize:14 marginTop:16. Badge rosso '#E85D4A' position:'absolute' top:16 right:16, testo bianco '-61%' fontWeight:700 fontSize:13, borderRadius:999, padding:'5px 12px'.

3. ILLUSTRATION (flex:1, display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'): usa <Remotion.Img src={assets['money-time-flow']} style={{width:520, maxWidth:'100%'}} />.

4. FOOTER (flex-shrink:0, height:72px, background brand-navy, display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'): testo 'finvestire.it' in brand-gold fontWeight:700 fontSize:18.

Background root: theme.colors.paper.
